title: POST /api/integration/notifications/handover (200)
description: Result per item: created (new at the hub), duplicates (the hub already had this id for the device: idempotent), skipped with a reason (client_not_found = unknown device or a watch whose phone is gone, id_conflict = id of another device, expired = older than 72 h, invalid = e.g. neither title nor message, popup_mode direct without a link). An item for a watch is created for the phone that set it up, as with POST /api/integration/notify (duplicates are checked against the phone). The hub rewrites the notification sensors once afterwards. A schema violation of the body is 422 for the whole call.
